description: HP-53 is the Registering & Licensing Authority (R&LA) for Baijnath in the Kangra district of Himachal Pradesh. This office is responsible for vehicle registration, issuance of driving licenses, and collection of road taxes for the Baijnath sub-division. It plays a crucial role in maintaining transport records for the region, which is famous for its ancient Shiva Temple and proximity to the Bir-Billing paragliding site.
address: Office of the Sub Divisional Officer (Civil), Baijnath, District Kangra, Himachal Pradesh
